# Suvra Mukherjee

Technical Business Analyst

I turn business questions into data driven analysis and clear technical requirements that move decisions forward.

## About

### From research questions to data driven delivery

I am an analyst who works where data, product, and delivery meet. My focus is translating what a business actually needs into requirements a team can build against, and defining the metrics that tell us whether it worked.

I began in research, working on predictive analytics and published methods, then moved into analytics and enterprise AI delivery. Today I work across enterprise AI and analytics, turning business needs into technical requirements, analyzing data to answer real questions, and defining the success metrics that show whether it worked.

Before engineering I trained for five years in fine arts and earned a diploma with distinction. That background shaped how I structure information and communicate it, clearly and with intent.

What's next: Pursuing postgraduate study and targeting Technical Business Analyst and Data Analyst roles, focused on analysis, technical requirements, and data driven products.

- Focus: Data analysis and technical requirements
- Currently: Business Analyst at Quantiphi Analytics
- Open to: Technical Business Analyst and Data Analyst roles

## Experience

### Quantiphi Analytics — Business Analyst (Jan 2025 to Present)

- Wrote the data and functional requirements for the Vector Store component of a $3M enterprise data platform, and coordinated with the engineering teams building around it.
- Defined how an AI coaching agent for more than 80,000 employees should work on Microsoft Copilot Studio, including intent routing and how it connects to company knowledge sources.
- Turned business requests into clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers could build and test against.
- Ran requirement gathering sessions with business and technical teams to agree on what to build and in what order.
- Analyzed usage and performance data to answer questions from the product and delivery teams.
- Ran sprint planning, daily standups, and backlog grooming to keep the work organized and on track.
- Wrote 4 analysis documents, more than 15 proposals, more than 25 slide decks, and more than 6 SOWs for client and internal leadership.

### Highradius Corporation — Marketing Intern (Jun 2024 to Dec 2024)

- Analyzed Salesforce CRM data with SQL to find where campaign conversion was dropping, which led to a 12% improvement in conversion rate.
- Built and ran reports on campaign and funnel performance so the marketing team could see what was working and what was not.
- Planned and wrote content across more than 30 SEO articles, which brought in more than 4,000 organic visitors.
- Tracked how each article and channel performed and used that to decide what content to produce next.

## Research

### Cardiologist Recommendation Framework using Predictive Analytics

A Naive Bayes classifier reaching 90.7% accuracy, combined with CoreNLP sentiment analysis, benchmarked against Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, SVM, and KNN.

Presented at ICCCNet 2024, Manchester Metropolitan University, United Kingdom. In collaboration with Xi'an Jiaotong Liverpool University and University of South Wales.
